instruction: Reverse the characters in each line of "cat\ndog\nbird" and save the result in output.txt

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

The evaluator uses a custom getter to read the output file and a custom metric to compare against expected text.
